member.name: GetProjectionAsync
member.summary: Retrieves a filtered, sorted, and projected read-only list directly via SQL SELECT.
member.typeparam: The target DTO type to project into.
member.param: LINQ Projection expression selecting only required columns.

member.name: GetPagedProjectedAsync
member.summary: Retrieves a paginated, filtered, and projected read-only list with a total record count.
member.typeparam: The target DTO type to project into.
member.param: LINQ Projection expression selecting only required columns.
member.returns: A tuple containing the paginated DTO items and the total matching records count.

member.name: AsQueryable
member.summary: Provides an for advanced dynamic querying and DTO projections.
member.remarks: Caution: Uses Deferred Execution. Do NOT call ToList() or AsEnumerable() prematurely to prevent loading entire tables into memory. Expose with care to avoid tight coupling.
